tasks.short: Develop and initially teach an actual online library-science course

steps.what: Read actual programme requirements, original library-science sources and existing course-platform constraints
outputs: Read original sources and explicit course/platform requirements

steps.what: Choose the actual learning outcomes, specialist content, activities, assessment approach and online teaching sequence
inputs: Actual requirements and original sources from s1
outputs: Teacher-selected course design and explicit outcome/content/activity field mapping

steps.what: Populate unpublished LMS course-section fields and links from the teacher's exact selected design and supported template mapping
inputs: Explicit selected design and field mapping from s2
Actual original source links from s1
outputs: Unpublished exact course skeleton and source links

steps.what: Write the actual instructional explanations and activity wording with bounded source-linked wording proposals
inputs: Chosen specialist course design from s2
outputs: Actual draft instructional content with checked source links

loop.purpose: Propose wording for the teacher's chosen actual online lessons
loop.input: Actual selected content and original source excerpts
loop.check: Teacher checks specialist meaning, every factual claim, activity feasibility and alignment with actual outcomes
loop.stop: Unsupported claim or changed pedagogical intent returns to manual writing with no publication
loop.why_not_simpler: The fixed LMS structure is handled in s3; instructional prose needs semantic checking

steps.what: Check the complete actual course, source accuracy, link access, activity instructions and learner view, correcting the final unpublished version
inputs: Original requirements and sources from s1
outputs: Exact complete checked unpublished course version

steps.what: Save the final unpublished course in the same LMS workspace
outputs: Stored exact unpublished course version

steps.what: Perform the actual existing independent initial-course release review and decide on the exact completed course version
inputs: Exact complete final course version from s6
outputs: Existing authority's release decision for the exact version or rejection

steps.what: Publish only that exact authorised course version to its intended actual learners through the existing LMS release route
inputs: Exact final course version from s6
outputs: Actual authorised course available to intended learners

steps.what: Actually teach the initial online sessions and learning activities, answer students and adapt explanations to their real understanding
outputs: Actual online teaching and student interaction

tasks.design: Populate the chosen course structure in {LMS} deterministically and use bounded source-linked wording help in {DOCS}. Retain specialist design, complete course checking, existing independent initial release and actual teaching; {OTHER} is the existing online teaching medium.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected course elements may be manually placed in repeated LMS fields and expressed in new instructional prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported unpublished-course templates permit fixed imports, and source-bound wording proposals can be checked against selected outcomes.
tasks.still_hard: Specialist content, pedagogical sequencing, learner needs and actual online interaction require the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands the discipline and responds to actual students.

ambition.what: Develop the real course with less repeated assembly while retaining actual teaching.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; confirm platform/source access, permitted model use and actual course release route

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed LMS templates can reuse selected course structure; instructional wording help requires subject and teaching checks, with no measured saving asserted.

assumptions: This is a representative development-and-initial-teaching episode, not an assumed annual development/teaching mix. Shares come from the work described, not the occupation prior; observe actual episode frequency before roll-up.

Actual source reading, specialist content selection and explicit field mapping are counted in s1/s2. No free finished curriculum or structured course feed is assumed. Existing native LMS import/template functions earn no new benefit.

The episode has a real existing independent initial-course release route. Course release authority names that actual role, not an invented supervisor or author self-approval. Map the actual route if different. The exact final version exists in s5/s6 before s7; any edit voids a1. The ordinary s6 save is negligible share1, fully retained and ungated.

tasks.short: Collaborate on actual teaching and research issues

steps.what: Read the actual issue paper, course material or research evidence through the existing current-document view
inputs: Actual teaching/research question and original working materials
outputs: Located and read original issue evidence

steps.what: Actually discuss the issue with colleagues, compare interpretations and constraints, and work through possible teaching or research responses
outputs: Actual shared understanding, proposed responses and unresolved disagreements

steps.what: Write and check the actual agreed update to the working issue paper, distinguishing suggestions, agreement and unresolved matters
outputs: Checked factual working-paper update

steps.what: Save the working update in the same document workspace
outputs: Stored actual working-paper update

tasks.design: Configure original current-issue lookup in {DOCS}, keeping actual collaboration separate from the genuine working-paper update. {OTHER} is the existing colleague meeting/call medium; no model decides colleagues' agreement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current issue paper and original supporting material can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native current-document view can shorten retrieval without producing the discussion outcome.
tasks.still_hard: Interpretation, compromise and the substance of a teaching/research response require the actual colleagues.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher contributes discipline knowledge and builds shared understanding.

ambition.what: Ease actual issue lookup without automating collaboration.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native current-document views can aid retrieval, while colleague collaboration and factual outcome writing remain actual human work.

assumptions: This episode actually updates an existing issue paper, not invented minutes after every conversation. Original source reading, live discussion, actual record writing and ordinary save are separated. Any episode without a written update has no such baseline.
Baseline100 retained98.5 gross1.5 minus0.3 new view upkeep=1.2; unmeasured work estimates independent of the prior. An already used native view earns no additional saving.

research_questions: Observe real source lookup, colleague discussion and existing working-paper writing separately.

tasks.short: Compile an actual specialist reading bibliography

steps.what: Search original catalogues and actual specialist materials, read for suitability, choose the reading items and capture their actual resolved records and edition identifiers
inputs: Actual catalogues and original specialist materials
outputs: Teacher-selected reading items with actual resolved bibliographic records and edition identifiers

steps.what: Import the exact selected records, deduplicate by explicit identifiers and format the selected reading bibliography in its fixed required style
inputs: Actual selected resolved records and identifiers from s1
outputs: Draft compiled bibliography with source links and unresolved metadata flagged

steps.what: Check every actual bibliography entry, edition, author/title, link and assignment suitability against the original selected material; correct unresolved metadata
inputs: Actual original selected material from s1
outputs: Complete checked specialist reading bibliography

steps.what: Save the checked compiled bibliography in the same working document
outputs: Stored actual compiled bibliography

tasks.design: Use actual catalogue/reference-manager records, represented by {OTHER}, for exact bibliography import, deduplication and style rendering in {DOCS}. Retain specialist reading/selection, original-record capture and every-entry checking; no model invents titles.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actually selected materials may be manually copied and reformatted into an assignment bibliography.
tasks.enabler_now: Resolved catalogue records and a fixed reference-manager style can produce repeatable citations without semantic generation.
tasks.still_hard: A valid citation can still name the wrong edition or a reading unsuitable for the actual assignment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher selects the discipline's useful material and verifies its exact identity.

ambition.what: Compile the actual selected reading list with less repeated metadata handling.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-2; confirm actual catalogue export and reference-manager access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: resolved catalogue metadata and reference-manager styles support deterministic bibliography generation; original item selection and edition checks remain necessary.

assumptions: s1 counts actual search, original reading, selection and resolved-record capture; no free curated bibliography is assumed. Items lacking actual metadata stay unresolved rather than being fabricated.
The30-point baseline requires observed manual record copying/formatting. Native catalogue export and reference-manager functions already used earn no new saving; use them first.

This produces the complete actual compiled bibliography requested by the statement. It does not hide assignment publication or student correspondence inside a working save; if an actual later issue occurs, count its existing final authority and separate send/publication step.

Baseline100 retained70 gross30 minus3 new style/import upkeep=27. Estimates are unmeasured task work independent of the prior. Ordinary same-system save is negligible minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval.

Low: specialist grey literature lacks resolved identifiers or edition metadata, retaining22 of30 entry/format points as manual work;8 points removed minus3 upkeep=5. inputs: Actual manuscript and original cited sources
outputs: Read original argument, sources and explicit editorial requirements

inputs: Actual manuscript and explicit rules from s1
outputs: Draft exact style/reference difference list with manuscript locations

inputs: Original manuscript meaning and requirements from s1
outputs: Actual tracked manuscript edits and source-grounded author queries

loop.purpose: Propose bounded copy edits without changing the specialist argument
loop.input: Actual manuscript passage and explicit journal/editor requirements
loop.output: Tracked copy-edit proposals and unresolved meaning queries
loop.check: Editor checks every changed claim, term, attribution and nuance against the actual original passage and sources
loop.stop: Changed meaning, uncertain attribution or unsupported correction stays manual and is queried; no automatic acceptance
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed style checks are s2; wording clarity requires semantic judgment

steps.what: Check the complete edited manuscript and author queries against original meaning and journal requirements, producing the exact final return version

steps.what: Save the exact final review copy in the same editorial workspace
steps.actor: library science teacher acting as journal editor
inputs: Final edited manuscript and queries from s4
outputs: Stored exact final editorial review copy

inputs: Exact final review package from s5
outputs: Handling editor's actual release decision for that exact package or rejection

tasks.design: Apply exact style/reference checks to the actual manuscript in {DOCS}, then use bounded tracked copy-edit proposals with every change checked for meaning. {OTHER} means the actual journal submission/reference tools; retain the existing independent handling-editor decision and separate author return.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated style/reference checks and wording edits may consume editorial time before whole-manuscript checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed style rules support exact checking, and bounded tracked wording proposals can be compared with original passages.
tasks.still_hard: Specialist meaning, source attribution and the acceptability of an editorial change require expert reading and author queries.
tasks.human_edge: The editor protects the author's argument while improving the actual manuscript.

ambition.what: Reduce repeatable editing work without replacing expert editorial responsibility.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; confirm actual manuscript confidentiality, permitted model use and existing journal review/return route

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed manuscript style checks are deterministic and bounded copy-edit proposals require expert meaning checks; no journal deployment or measured time claim is asserted.

assumptions: This is an actual journal editorial assignment with an existing distinct handling-editor return review, not an invented reviewer or author self-approval. The teacher is acting within that journal's editorial workflow and the manuscript author is external. Map the actual route if it differs; do not add review labour solely to create a gate.

Original manuscript/source reading and editorial requirement capture are counted in s1. The helper neither verifies the truth of the argument by style rules nor invents source metadata. Native checking already used earns no new saving.

The complete final package exists in s4/s5 before s6. Any change invalidates a1. s5 is a negligible ordinary same-system save at minimum share1, fully retained and ungated. s7 is the separate actual external return; it is not the ordinary save or final journal publication.
